title: Pricing tiers with a lifted featured plan
summary: Auto-fit columns of equal-height plans, with the featured one lifted above its neighbours on wide screens.
explanation: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)) makes as many plan columns as fit. Each column is at least 200px and they share the rest equally, so the row reflows without a media query.

Each plan is a flex column with its feature list set to flex: 1. Plans stretch to the tallest one in the row, and the list grows to fill the gap, so the price and button line up along the bottom in every card.

On wide screens the featured plan gets a negative margin-top and position: relative with z-index: 1. It rises above its row neighbours without changing their size. z-index only works because the element is positioned, which is the common trap.
tryThis: Remove position: relative from .featured: the lift stops working, and z-index is ignored.
Change align-items to flex-start on .pricing: the plans shrink to their content and their bottoms stop lining up.
Change auto-fit to auto-fill and narrow the preview: empty columns appear at the end of the row.
